source_verification_receipts.locator: Article landing page and abstract metadata
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives conditions for Markov equivalence of maximal ancestral graphs, including the ordered-collider criterion used as background here.
The work restricts one MAG equivalence class by expert edge-mark knowledge, gives sound rules, proves representation only in specified settings, and otherwise provides a checking algorithm.

The paper gives polynomial-delay listing for a single MAG MEC using singleton background knowledge and locally complete rules, while noting general background-knowledge completeness remains unresolved.
The paper studies post-treatment selection with latent confounding, introduces FI-Markov equivalence and F-PAG, and states soundness and completeness of F-FCI under that different timing semantics.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Split the observational regime from nonobservational twin regimes in every definition: Tw(η,0) should have no ζ node and its projection should be on V; restrict ζ_k constructions to k≥1.

State the rule-matching cost and the finite input representation for each SI rule, then convert the endpoint-update potential into an explicit total runtime or termination certificate for the oracle-MAG input.
Add a generic, non-two-variable family showing that independent regime-wise MAG completions fail common-basal-DAG realizability, with a precise obstruction certified by the proposed calculus.

recommended_next_step: Repair the k=0 indicator/projection semantics, then retain the field-grade completeness kernel and advance the revised core to Stage 0.
